item.title: OpenMacApps: 1,800+ open-source Mac apps, checked against their license files
item.description: Eleven open-source Mac app lists and Homebrew's install data gave me the leads. Reading the actual license files, not GitHub's license field, decided which 1,800+ apps made it into OpenMacApps.
